name: Andréanne Bergeron
biography: Andréanne Bergeron has a Ph.D. in criminology from the University of Montreal and works as a cybersecurity researcher at GoSecure. Acting as the social and data scientist of the team, she is interested in online attackers’ behaviors. She is an experienced presenter with over 38 academic conferences and is now focusing on the infosec field. She has presented at BSides Montreal, NorthSec, CypherCon and Human Factor in Cybercrime amongst others.
